_note: Fictional RAID log for the offline demo. Dates are absolute; the demo snapshot is as of 2026-10-16.

items.title: SSO and MFA rollout blocked on the identity team
items.description: The identity team has not scheduled the PLM SAML integration; the open cybersecurity finding stays open until it ships.
items.mitigation: Escalate to the identity team's director; agree a two-week slot.

items.title: No one owns the legacy part export classification backfill
items.description: About 40,000 legacy parts have no export classification and no business owner has been named to review them.
items.mitigation: Name a Trade Compliance owner and fund reviewer time.

items.title: SAP S/4 transport window from the SAP CoE
items.description: The upsert service needs a production transport window from the SAP Center of Excellence.
items.mitigation: Request the window in the CoE change board on Oct 20.

items.title: Silent BOM transfer failures continue
items.description: Two BOM transfers failed without alerting this month; plants found them on the line.
items.mitigation: Daily failed-transfer report until the error dashboard ships.

items.title: Vault vendor support ends in 2027
items.description: The legacy vault loses vendor support; migration waves must finish first.
items.mitigation: Wave plan agreed with eMobility; read-only mode first.

items.title: Top 50 suppliers will use the portal for acknowledgements
items.description: Supplier quality expects the top 50 suppliers to acknowledge change notices in the portal.

items.title: Supplier portal licences cost more than planned
items.description: Per-supplier licence pricing is above the budget assumption.
items.mitigation: Negotiate a tiered price for low-volume suppliers.
